propositions: The check_raw_git_writes lint gate already correctly detects attribute-form git wrapper calls (e.g. core._git(), self._git()) via the ast.Attribute branch in _wrapper_name, but this capability is undocumented and entirely untested, making it appear absent.

All existing tests in test_raw_git_write_lint.py exercise only bare-name wrapper calls (ast.Name form), leaving attribute-form detection unvalidated and vulnerable to accidental removal in future refactors.

The _ref_lock_push.py file contains a wrapper call (push_lease_cas) that correctly does not fire because push is not in MUTATION_VERBS, but this correct non-firing behavior is undocumented and unpinned by tests.

The gate's module docstring claims coverage only of bare-name detection (BY NAME), when in fact the callable name is extracted from either ast.Name or ast.Attribute indiscriminately, making the design implicit rather than explicit.
